notes.title: Retry count for billing-api is 5
notes.body: Retry count for outgoing billing-api calls is 5 (was 3), agreed with Anna Nowak because of timeouts in PAY-1234.

notes.title: Retry count for billing-api is 3
notes.body: We use 3 retries with exponential backoff for billing-api calls. Agreed in sprint planning.

notes.title: Open the ad server admin panel locally
notes.body: To open the ad server admin panel locally: start the VPN, run `make adserver-up` in the infra repo, then open http://localhost:8443/admin. Login uses the staging SSO account.

notes.title: Root cause of auth token bug
notes.body: The auth bug in PAY-1180 was caused by tokens expiring 5 minutes early because of clock drift between the gateway and the auth service. Fixed by adding 60s leeway to token validation.

notes.title: Get access to the staging database
notes.body: To get read access to the staging Postgres database, ask the DevOps team in the #infra-help Teams channel. Access is granted for 30 days.

notes.title: Library reqflow does not support streaming
notes.body: The reqflow HTTP library does not support streaming response bodies. Use hyper directly when responses can be large.

notes.title: Fix timeout config in billing-api

notes.title: Rust question mark operator
notes.body: In Rust, the `?` operator returns early from the function with the error when a Result is Err, converting it with From::from.

notes.title: SQLite WAL mode for concurrent readers
notes.body: SQLite needs WAL journal mode (PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL) to let readers work while a writer is active. Found while fixing a lock error in the reporting job.

notes.title: Refactor the auth module
notes.body: We should split the auth module into token validation and session management someday. Nobody owns this yet.

notes.title: Use SQLite for nv
notes.body: I decided to use SQLite with FTS5 for nv instead of a separate vector database, because the store is small and must work offline.

notes.title: Run integration tests locally
notes.body: Integration tests need DOCKER_HOST set to the Colima socket on macOS: export DOCKER_HOST=unix://$HOME/.colima/default/docker.sock, then run `cargo test --features integration`.

notes.title: Debug flaky tests with a fixed seed
notes.body: To debug flaky property tests, fix the random seed with PROPTEST_RNG_SEED and rerun the failing case until it reproduces.

notes.body: Maybe nv should store screenshots or diagrams as notes later. Not for the MVP.

notes.title: Cosine similarity with normalized vectors
notes.body: When embedding vectors are normalized to length 1, cosine similarity is the same as the dot product, so search can skip the division.
